nodes.label: CoreService
nodes.rationale: Designed following domain-driven design principles to ensure high cohesion and low coupling.

nodes.label: Worker Service
nodes.rationale: Configured with automatic restart, watchtower for auto-updates, and strict CPU limits (1 CPU, 300MB RAM) for resource isolation on GPU nodes.

nodes.label: Worker Executor (YOLO Training)
nodes.rationale: Simulates/executes YOLO training in an isolated Docker container managed dynamically by the worker invoker to prevent resource leakage on host.
